title: Fire extinguisher at home or work? Get it checked
lines: Got a fire extinguisher? When was it last checked?
Extinguishers need periodic checks by a certified inspector.
We check the gauge, the pin, the hose, and look for rust or damage.
And that it hangs somewhere easy to reach, not blocked.
A working extinguisher is the difference between a small problem and a fire.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
